## Codex 重置预测看板 2.3.4

- 未登录账号到达上次记录的预计重置时间后，自动开启七天模拟周期，继续显示倒计时和红线。实际消耗保留上次读数。
- 宣传页首次打开时显示简体中文，并保存之后主动选择的语言。

- 当前账号有足够的当天额度采样时，金点显示预计重置时的用量。若预计提前用完，显示预计用完时间和提前的小时、分钟。

## English

- Inactive accounts start a simulated seven-day cycle when the last known reset time passes. The countdown and pace marker keep moving, and the last measured usage remains visible.
- The feature tour opens in Simplified Chinese by default and remembers subsequent language choices.

- With enough same-day readings for the current account, a gold dot shows projected usage at reset. If quota is projected to run out early, the dashboard shows the estimated time and lead in hours and minutes.
